BrochureContent.Content:
Dixon Residential Estate Agents are delighted to present 64 Captains Avenue to the highly sought-after Kimmage property market.

Upon entering the property, you are welcomed by a spacious entrance hallway leading to a bright and comfortable living room. To the rear, the kitchen/dining area benefits from a generous extension, offering excellent flexibility. This additional space could be incorporated into a larger open-plan kitchen, used as a home office, playroom, games room, or even an additional bedroom, subject to further planning permission.

Upstairs, the accommodation comprises two spacious double bedrooms and a modern family bathroom.

Externally, the property boasts a large front garden with off-street parking for multiple vehicles. The substantial rear garden provides an ideal space for family life, outdoor entertaining, gardening, or future potential to extend (subject to planning permission).

Plenty of neighbours have also extended to the side which would provide a great use of space, this would be subject to planning permission.

Captains Avenue is a highly desirable residential address situated between Stannaway Avenue and Lower Kimmage, placing it within easy reach of the established neighbourhoods of Kimmage, Crumlin, Harold’s Cross and Terenure. Sundrive and Ashleaf Shopping Centres are just minutes away, offering an excellent range of shops, cafés, restaurants and everyday amenities.

Families are exceptionally well catered for, with a wide selection of highly regarded primary and secondary schools nearby. The villages of Sundrive, Kimmage, Terenure and Harold’s Cross are all within comfortable walking or cycling distance, providing an abundance of local services, dining options and community facilities.

Recreational amenities are plentiful, with Bushy Park, renowned for its weekend market, scenic walking trails and extensive sporting facilities, located approximately 2km away. Even closer are Eamonn Ceannt Park and Stannaway Park, both offering excellent green spaces for leisure and outdoor activities.

The location also benefits from excellent transport links, with convenient access to Dublin City Centre and the M50 motorway, connecting seamlessly to the wider national road network.

Early viewing is highly recommended.
